subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in missing-argument prompt contract for native commands, and should Telegram map that contract to ForceReply for commands such as `/btw` and `/steer`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the durable fix changes command semantics and possibly plugin SDK/gateway command metadata; automation should not choose which commands prompt or how other native channels should behave.

options.title: Add Opt-In Prompt Metadata
options.body: Define a command-level prompt descriptor or portable prompt action, enable it only for selected freeform-argument commands, and map Telegram to ForceReply.

options.title: Keep Usage-Only Behavior
options.body: Leave bare menu taps as usage replies until there is a broader native-command prompt design.

options.title: Prototype Telegram-Only
options.body: Add a local Telegram special case for a small command allowlist, accepting the risk that core command metadata and other native surfaces drift.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Prompt Metadata
recommendation.body: Define a command-level prompt descriptor or portable prompt action, enable it only for selected freeform-argument commands, and map Telegram to ForceReply.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision cuts across command semantics and native channel UX, and this user has the strongest recent command-surface/product-routing history in the inspected evidence.
